questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Only a few Bs are Qs.

Only a few Qs are Vs.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Bs are Vs.

II. All Qs can never be Vs.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69819df5a94109e19856d62b0067179cc3bc3d7fa0a51d1f341dbb40d8c16aae.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Bs are Vs → False (There is no definite relation between B and V as Only a few Bs are Qs and Only a few Qs are Vs so, Some Bs are Vs is false)

II. All Qs can never be Vs → True (As Only a few Qs are Vs so, All Qs can never be Vs is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows". **

Hence, the correct answer is **"(9, 81, 729)".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and also ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

4 ÷ 6 − 9 + 48 × 8 = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Given equation is : 4 ÷ 6 − 9 + 48 × 8 = ?

After interchanging the ‘+’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and also ‘×’ and ‘÷’ the equation formed is : 4 × 6 + 9 - 48 ÷ 8 = ?

= 4 × 6 + 9 - __**48 ÷ 8 **__

= __**4 × 6**__ + 9 - 6

= __**24 + 9**__ - 6

= __**33 - 6**__

**= 27**

Hence, the correct answer is **"27".**

questions.solution:

**Second number = First number³ + 2**

 
• 7 : 345 → 7³ + 2 = 343 + 2 = 345
 
• 5 : 127 → 5³ + 2 = 125 + 2 = 127
 
• **6 : ? → 6³ + 2 = 216 + 2 = 218**

Hence, the correct answer is** "218".**

questions.question: The age of five sisters Sita, Gita, Babita, Lalita and Anita are compared. Gita is elder than Babita but younger than Sita. Lalita is the eldest. Babita is not the youngest. Who is the second eldest sister?
questions.solution:
The age of five sisters Sita, Gita, Babita, Lalita and Anita are compared. 

1) Gita is elder than Babita but younger than Sita.

⇒ Sita > Gita > Babita

2) Lalita is the eldest and Babita is not the youngest.

⇒ Lalita > Sita > Gita > Babita > Anita

∴ Here, 'Sita' is second eldest sister among five.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sita".**

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All cars are trucks.

Some bikes are cars.

**Conclusions:**

I. All bikes are trucks.

II. Some trucks are bikes.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59db9b42c3f8e35aaf0314178fd2d118f518745e4abdb3f8dad8abf18459db21.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bikes are trucks → False (As All cars are trucks and Some bikes are cars so, All bikes are trucks is false.)

II. Some trucks are bikes → True (As All cars are trucks and Some bikes are cars so, Some trucks are bikes is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**

questions.question:
Which of the mathematical signs should be interchanged in the given equation to make it mathematically correct?

102 − 17 + 12 × 4 ÷ 27 + 5 = 32
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : − and ÷

Given equation : 102 − 17 + 12 × 4 ÷ 27 + 5 = 32

After interchanging the symbols in the given equation the equation formed is as follows: 102 ÷ 17 + 12 × 4 - 27 + 5 = 32

⇒ __**102 ÷ 17**__ + 12 × 4 - 27 + 5 = 32

⇒ 6 + __**12 × 4**__ - 27 + 5 = 32

⇒ __**6 + 48**__ - 27 __**+ 5**__ = 32

⇒ __**59 - 27**__ = 32

**⇒ 32 = 32**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2): − and ×

Given equation : 102 − 17 + 12 × 4 ÷ 27 + 5 = 32

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 102 × 17 + 12 - 4 ÷ 27 + 5 = 32

⇒ 102 × 17 + 12 - __**4 ÷ 27**__ + 5 = 32

⇒ __**102 × 17**__ + 12 - 0.148 + 5 = 32

⇒ __**1734 + 12**__ - 0.148 __**+ 5**__ = 32

⇒ __**1751 - 0.148**__ = 32

⇒ 1750.852 ≠ 32

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : × and ÷

Given equation : 102 − 17 + 12 × 4 ÷ 27 + 5 = 32

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 102 - 17 + 12 ÷ 4 × 27 + 5 = 32

⇒ 102 - 17 + __**12 ÷ 4**__ × 27 + 5 = 32

⇒ 102 - 17 + __**3 × 27**__ + 5 = 32

⇒ __**102**__ - 17 __**+ 81 + 5**__ = 32

⇒ __**188 - 17 **__= 32

⇒ 171 ≠ 32

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4): − and +

Given equation : 102 − 17 + 12 × 4 ÷ 27 + 5 = 32

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 102 + 17 - 12 × 4 ÷ 27 + 5 = 32

⇒ 102 + 17 - 12 × __**4 ÷ 27**__ + 5 = 32

⇒ 102 + 17 - __**12 × 0.148**__ + 5 = 32

⇒ __**102 + 17**__ - 1.776 __**+ 5**__ = 32

⇒ __**124 - 1.776**__ = 32

⇒ 122.224 ≠ 32

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"− and ÷".**
